content: Hi Linda! I kept thinking about our conversation last night. You honestly make my evenings feel brighter.
That's so sweet of you to say, Mark. I haven't smiled like this in a long time.
I mean every word. I know things haven't been easy for you lately, but you deserve real happiness, and someone who treats you right.
It's been tough since the divorce, honestly. But talking with you makes me feel hopeful again.
You're incredibly strong. I admire that. I started my new job at the architecture firm this week, and you were on my mind the whole time.
I'm glad we met, even if it's just online for now. How's the new job?

It's exciting, but overwhelming too. The team's great, but I miscalculated, my first paycheck doesn't arrive until the end of next month. Feeling a bit embarrassed, but I wanted to be honest with you.
Oh, that sounds stressful. Is everything okay? Can I help?

Honestly, I'm struggling to cover rent and groceries for the next couple of weeks. I've never asked for help like this before, but I trust you. Would you maybe be able to lend me a little? I promise I'll pay you back as soon as my salary comes in.
You really trust me that much? I want to help if I can. How much do you need?
I appreciate you so much, Linda. It's just $200 to cover the basics, nothing more. I know it's a lot to ask, especially since we haven't met in person yet.
No, I get it. I know what it's like to feel alone and need a little support. How would I send it to you?

You're truly one of a kind. If it's easiest, you could buy two $100 Apple gift cards at your local store and send me the codes here. That way I can pay my landlord and get groceries instantly, since bank transfers are so slow here.
I think I can do that. I've never bought gift cards for someone before, but I want to help you.
Thank you, Linda. I know this is unusual. You're showing me what real kindness looks like, something I haven't felt in years.
I'm just glad I can do something. I'll go to the store after work and let you know when I have the cards.
You're amazing. When we finally meet, dinner's on me, I promise. Just send a photo of the codes or type them out when you have them. I trust you completely.
Okay, I'll message you later tonight. I hope this helps you get by until payday.
It means more than you know. You're making a real difference in my life, Linda.
You make me feel special too, Mark. I just want to see you happy.
And I want to make you happy, always. Thank you for being there for me.
